open_points.subject: assign_staff_project
open_points.text: assign_staff_project: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST authorize access management, validate the Registry UUID server-side with validate_project_reference before opening the mutation transaction, reject duplicate active assignment, and append the staff_assignment.create member of = models.AuditAction atomically.
open_points.question: Must the note name the enum member STAFF_ASSIGNMENT_CREATE instead of calling its serialized value staff_assignment.create a member?

open_points.subject: assign_staff_project
open_points.text: assign_staff_project: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST build the new = models.StaffProjectAssignment with the imported build_staff_project_assignment, passing the one utc_now instant as now, the operator_id, the validated project_id and the authorized administrator context. It MUST build exactly one audit intent with the imported build_staff_audit_intent, passing as action the staff_assignment.create member of = models.AuditAction, as entity_kind the STAFF_ASSIGNMENT member of = models.AuditEntityKind, as entity_id the assignment_id of the built assignment and as project_id the assigned project.
open_points.question: Must the action argument be the STAFF_ASSIGNMENT_CREATE member rather than the serialized value staff_assignment.create?

open_points.subject: authenticate_staff
open_points.text: authenticate_staff: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST append, through the audit repository PortalTransaction.audit returns, exactly one audit on every outcome and commit it before it returns or raises, its intent built with the imported build_staff_login_audit_intent: passing the staff.login member of = models.AuditAction with the SUCCESS member of = models.AuditResult when a session was issued, and its staff.login_failed member with the REJECTED member of = models.AuditResult on every rejection, including an unknown email, a non-active account and a wrong password. As actor_id it MUST pass the staff_id of the persisted account and as entity_id the canonical string of that identifier, and None for both when no account matched the normalized email. The concealed rejection is raised only after that commit, so the record survives the failure.
open_points.question: Must the note name STAFF_LOGIN and STAFF_LOGIN_FAILED instead of treating their serialized values as enum member names?

open_points.subject: change_staff_status
open_points.text: change_staff_status: [BEHAVIOR] MUST append exactly one audit, its intent built with the imported build_staff_audit_intent, passing as action the member chosen by the target status — the staff.suspend member of = models.AuditAction, its staff.disable member, or its staff.reinstate member for either transition into active — as entity_kind the STAFF_ACCOUNT member of = models.AuditEntityKind, as entity_id that staff_id and as project_id None. Suspension and disabling MUST additionally revoke every session of that account that is neither revoked nor expired, each replaced with the imported revise_staff_session at the same instant as revoked_at, because suspending or disabling an account ends its sessions; the account has nothing else to revoke.
open_points.other_text: STAFF_DISABLE='staff.disable', STAFF_LOGIN='staff.login', STAFF_LOGIN_FAILED='staff.login_failed', STAFF_LOGOUT='staff.logout', STAFF_RECOVERY_OVERRIDE='staff.recovery_override', STAFF_REINSTATE='staff.reinstate', STAFF_SESSIONS_REVOKE='staff.sessions_revoke', STAFF_SUSPEND='staff.suspend'
open_points.question: Must the action choices be STAFF_SUSPEND, STAFF_DISABLE, and STAFF_REINSTATE rather than their serialized values?
